flagged.evidence: The current Definition says, “A bundle sector is one equivalence class under this relation,” then places “[P]” in a set Σ. Its current SHA256 matches the in-run finding’s observed hash. Relabeling a bundle’s total space by {α}×P yields proper-class many isomorphic set-coded presentations, so the literal equivalence class [P] is a proper class and cannot be an element of a set. No set-sized representative system or code is supplied.

The Definition says, “Its isomorphism class belongs to the model-specified set Σ of admitted bundle sectors,” and that “Σ may be a singleton.” Under its cited bundle-sector definition, [P] is the proper class of all isomorphic presentations, not a set element; the item supplies no set-sized coding or representative system.
